mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ai_capability_client WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0
AND (client_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR client_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND status = #{status} ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM ai_capability_client WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_capability_client WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND client_code = #{clientCode} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ai_capability_client WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'ENABLED' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, client_name ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM ai_capability_client WHERE key_id = #{keyId} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_capability_client WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_capability_client SET key_id = #{keyId}, key_prefix = #{keyPrefix}, key_hash = #{keyHash}, credential_version = credential_version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED' AND credential_version = #{credentialVersion}

UPDATE ai_capability_client SET signing_key_cipher = #{signingKeyCipher}, signing_key_version = signing_key_version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED' AND signing_key_version = #{signingKeyVersion}

UPDATE ai_capability_client SET user_assertion_enabled = 1, user_assertion_key_id = #{keyId}, user_assertion_public_key = #{publicKeyPem}, user_assertion_key_version = COALESCE(user_assertion_key_version, 0) + 1, credential_version = credential_version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED' AND credential_version = #{credentialVersion} AND COALESCE(user_assertion_key_version, 0) = #{expectedKeyVersion}

UPDATE ai_capability_client SET user_assertion_enabled = 0, credential_version = credential_version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED' AND credential_version = #{credentialVersion} AND COALESCE(user_assertion_key_version, 0) = #{expectedKeyVersion}

UPDATE ai_capability_client SET user_assertion_mapping_mode = #{mappingMode}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED' AND credential_version = #{credentialVersion}

UPDATE ai_capability_client SET status = 'REVOKED', credential_version = credential_version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED' AND credential_version = #{credentialVersion}

UPDATE ai_capability_client SET oauth_enabled = #{oauthEnabled}, oauth_client_type = #{oauthClientType}, credential_version = credential_version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED' AND credential_version = #{credentialVersion}
